findings.text: follow-on: the done-when required ruff check and ruff format --check to add no findings on the changed Python files, but the manifest records no ruff log or result, so the clause can only be re-checked by re-measuring; doing so gives 2 UP017 findings in reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py at both base and head with none inside the changed hunk, and tests/test_an_unreadable_diff_owes_the_full_review.py clean, which is a zero delta but not a receipt in the run directory.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports status complete, commit 13b40c0198db5eb230d6ac0c5afb17552dcc2c6b, three changed paths, and it discloses both the base-arm substitution and that no reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py change was needed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the fence granted in the source run's prompt.txt; all three changed paths (reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py, tests/test_an_unreadable_diff_owes_the_full_review.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-is-sized-to-its-risk/an-unreadable-diff-owes-the-full-review.html) are inside it.

justifications.durability: tests/test_an_unreadable_diff_owes_the_full_review.py:78-88 and :91-100 are driven to failure by reinstating the defect (logs/negative-control.log), and every assertion compares the resolver's tier against a repository the test itself constructs rather than against a value handed to the code under test.
justifications.evidence: logs/head-arm.log and logs/base-arm.log end in EXIT=0 (68 and 64 passed, zero failures) and logs/negative-control.log ends EXIT=1 with the two guard tests reddened, and I re-ran tests/test_an_unreadable_diff_owes_the_full_review.py at the head (4 passed); the base arm is a clone rather than the named git worktree (manifest.md:19) and the ruff clause at manifest.md:11 carries no recorded receipt.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:774 reads the availability mark with the same idiom the sibling reader at :1775 already uses (cumulative.changed_lines.get("available", True)), and the new test filename and the evidence-fragment slug are descriptive with no plan label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:774 carries the unavailable mark out as bool(lines.get("available", True)), and _run_review_tier at :809-810 returns review_tiers.FULL for an unmeasured scope, which is exactly the goal; the base-arm tree at 644c5514e3 still reads True at that line, so the change is the one the goal names.
justifications.reuse: the change consumes the available mark that reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:_committed_scope already owns (:144-147) instead of re-reading git itself, and a capability search over reckon/ for readers of that mark found only promotion_checks.py:1775 and promotion_evidence.py:167, both already honouring it, so no capability is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 644c5514e3 13b40c019 touches only reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py, tests/test_an_unreadable_diff_owes_the_full_review.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-is-sized-to-its-risk/an-unreadable-diff-owes-the-full-review.html, all inside the dispatch fence, though section 11's own body names only the first two of those.
